categories.main_business_segments: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. operates three primary business segments: Airfreight Services, Ocean Freight and Ocean Services, and Customs Brokerage and Other Services. These segments encompass a broad range of global logistics solutions, including freight consolidation and forwarding, customs clearance, warehousing and distribution, and specialized project cargo handling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Expeditors utilizes a proprietary, globally integrated technology platform developed in-house by logistics and IT professionals. This platform supports centralized and distributed operations, providing advanced analytics, real-time visibility, and digital solutions for quoting, booking, tracking, and reporting. The company emphasizes organic growth and does not outsource core technology development, ensuring consistency and agility across its global network.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diversified customer base across industries such as electronics, high technology, healthcare, aerospace, manufacturing, oil and energy, automotive, retail, and fashion. Its customers are primarily businesses engaged in international trade, with no single customer accounting for more than 5% of revenues, and it targets logistics and supply chain management professionals within these organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: Expeditors operates in over 60 countries with 176 district offices and approximately 450 total locations worldwide, organized into five geographic segments: Americas, North Asia, South Asia, Europe, and Middle East, Africa and India. The company maintains a strong presence in North Asia (notably China), Europe, and North America, with additional coverage through branch offices and independent agents.
categories.supply_chain_position: Expeditors acts as a non-asset-based third-party logistics provider, operating primarily as an intermediary between shippers and asset-based carriers (airlines, ocean carriers, and trucking companies). The company is positioned downstream in the supply chain, focusing on value-added logistics, consolidation, and supply chain optimization rather than owning transportation assets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include sustainable, profitable organic growth, expanding services in and out of Europe and China, and strengthening customs brokerage in South Asia and India. Expeditors invests heavily in technology innovation, digital solutions, and process consistency, with a focus on supply chain visibility, compliance, and tailored customer solutions. R&D is directed toward enhancing its proprietary platform and developing new digital products.
categories.revenue_model: Expeditors generates revenue primarily through the resale of purchased cargo space (air and ocean) at a markup, as well as fees for customs brokerage, warehousing, distribution, and value-added logistics services. Revenue is recognized as services are rendered, with ancillary income from consulting, insurance, and specialized project cargo solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global logistics industry is highly competitive, with Expeditors facing competition from both large multinational logistics firms and regional/niche players, as well as asset-based carriers expanding into logistics and new technology-driven entrants. Expeditors differentiates itself through its global network, integrated technology, compliance focus, and organic growth strategy, positioning itself as a leading non-asset-based provider with a full suite of services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, Expeditors reported total revenues of $16.5 billion, a 72% increase over 2020, with net earnings attributable to shareholders of $1.4 billion (up 103% year-over-year). The company has a strong balance sheet with $1.7 billion in cash and no long-term debt, and has demonstrated robust growth driven by high demand, capacity constraints, and elevated freight rates during the period.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Expeditors emphasizes tailored, customer-centric logistics solutions delivered through a consistent global platform, leveraging deep industry expertise, compliance, and advanced technology. Its non-asset-based model provides flexibility, scalability, and cost efficiency, while its focus on organic growth, employee development, and incentive-based compensation fosters superior service and operational excellence.
